name: Zhukov Ambient Occlusion
definition: A technique to simulate indirect illumination by attenuating ambient light based on the occlusion of nearby geometry, approximating darkening effects in obscured areas.
summary: Zhukov Ambient Occlusion is an empirical model that approximates indirect illumination by attenuating the Phong ambient term based on geometric obscurance, offering a computationally cheaper alternative to radiosity.
